items.requirement: 3.1–3.3 Allocation never loses a minor unit
items.tested: 1,000,000 seeded random splits (2–7 parts, equal or weighted 1–10) across GBP, EUR, USD, CHF, JPY and KWD, checking that the parts add back to the total
items.context: Integer minor units + largest-remainder allocation vs splitting major-unit floats and rounding each share
items.baseline: floats: 767,538 units lost in 571,547 of 1,000,000 splits

items.requirement: 2.1–2.3 Exact FX conversion with banker's rounding
items.tested: 1,000,000 seeded conversions between the six currencies at ECB fixture rates, compared with an independent exact BigInt reference
items.context: Engine (rational rates, half-even) vs Math.round(amount × rate) on floats; float errors counted against both half-even and its own half-up policy
items.metric: Conversions differing from the exact result
items.baseline: floats: 183 wrong even by their own half-up rule (346 vs half-even)

items.requirement: 4.2 Round trips and running balances (reported even where floats tie)
items.tested: 1,000,000 A→B→A round trips at mid rate, and a 1,000,000-posting running balance
items.context: Both methods must round to the intermediate currency's minor unit, so round trips lose up to a couple of units either way
items.value: engine max 2 units (mean signed -0.00012) · ledger drift 0
items.baseline: floats max 2 units (mean signed 0.00016) · ledger drift 0 after rounding (no measurable advantage here)
